Antecedentes Clínicos:
Sospecha de rotura meniscal.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteración de señal difusa de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservados, sin criterios de rotura.
Amplio defecto de espesor total con tenues cambios óseos reactivos en el tercio posterior de
carga del cóndilo femoral lateral, se extiende 8 mm medio lateral y 14 mm anteroposterior.
Úlceras parciales de espesor mayor y menor al 50% en el cartílago femorotibial medial en ambas
superficies articulares hacia la región intercondílea y de espesor parcial en el cartílago del platillo
tibial lateral. Úlceras de espesor parcial en el tercio posterior de no carga del cóndilo femoral
medial y de espesor completo con tenues cambios reactivos en el tercio posterior de no carga del
cóndilo femoral lateral.
Cartílago rotuliano con alteración de señal e irregularidad superficial a nivel del vértice y faceta
lateral.
Defecto de espesor total en la vertiente medial de la tróclea hacia la región central sin cambios
óseos reactivos, se extiende 8 mm medio lateral y 12 mm craneocaudal.
Discreto engrosamiento con alteración de señal del tendón cuadricipital distal.
Leve engrosamiento y alteración de señal del tendón rotuliano proximal y distal.
Restantes tendones regionales de espesor y señal conservados.
Moderado derrame articular. No se observa quiste de Baker. Pequeños cuerpos condrales
intraarticular de hasta 5 mm en el receso menisco tibial lateral.
Planos musculares de trofismo y señal conservados.
Impresión:
Amplio defecto condral grado 4 en el tercio posterior de carga del cóndilo femoral lateral.
Condropatía femorotibial con úlceras grado 2 y 3 en ambas superficies articulares mediales, grado
2 en platillo tibial lateral y tercio posterior de no carga del cóndilo femoral medial y grado 4 en
tercio posterior de no carga del cóndilo femoral lateral.
Condropatía rotuliana grado 2 en vértice y faceta lateral.
Defecto condral grado 3-4 en vertiente medial de la tróclea.
Tendinosis cuadricipital y rotuliana.
Moderado derrame articular. Pequeños cuerpos condrales en receso menisco tibial lateral

There is normal knee joint alignment.  
   No bone contusion is noted.   
     
   Normal ACL orientation with intact ligament fiber is observed.  No anterior tibial translation is noted.  
   PCL is intact.  
  
    MCL is intact.    
     Peripheral horizontal tear at posterior horn of the medial meniscus is detected. 
  
   FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons are preserved.  
   Normal shape with preserved signal of the lateral meniscus is observed.   
  
   Normal PF joint alignment.    
    Fullthickness cartilage tear, about 12x8mm., at mid to lower lateral patellar facet, with focal subchondral bone change and small cyst, is noted.   
  The medial and lateral patellar retinacula are preserved.  
  Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. 
  
  Minimal amount of PF joint effusion with suprapatellar fluid and mild thickened synovial tissue are observed.   Fullthickness cartilage tear, 12x8mm., at mid to lower lateral patellar facet, with focal subchondral bone change; Chondropathy grade 4.   
  Mild MCL sprain  
  Peripheral horizontal tear at posterior horn of the medial meniscus 
   Mild reactive synovitis of the PF joint

In the medial compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis along weight-baring, non weight-baring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes 
 The lateral compartment, there is radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis along weight-baring lateral femoral condyle. Focal high grade chondrosis with subchondral edema at lateral tibial plateau (about 1.8* 2 cm). Osteophytes are present.  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial, lateral patellar facets, medial and lateral trochleas. There is no subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 There is chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is anterior tibial translation. 
 There is chronic partial tear of the posteromedial oblique ligament. Chronic partial tears of the medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are suspected. The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Large amount of effusion with synovitis is present in right knee including popliteus recess. There are multiple osteocartilaginous loose bodies (about 1-2.5 cm) in right knee including suprapatellar bursa and popliteal recess. The surrounding musculature is normal.   -- Moderate tri-compartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral edema, cysts and osteophytes. 
 -- Radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. 
 -- Radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.  
 -- Chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.  
 -- Chronic partial tear of the posteromedial oblique ligament.  
 -- Chronic partial tears of the medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes. 
 -- Large amount of effusion with synovitis and multiple loose bodies (about 1-2.5 cm) in right knee including suprapatellar bursa and popliteal recess: probable for secondary synovial osteochondromatosis.

Lateralisiert stehende Patella. Ansonsten regelrechte Artikulationsverhältnisse. Tiefgreifender, bis an den knochenreichender Knorpeldefekt an der lateralen Patellafacette großflächig mit bis zu 1,7 cm und chondralen Fibrillationen (4/8). Angrenzend teils geringes Knochenmarködem (5/8). Femorotibial regelrechte Stellung. V. a. horizontale Rissbildung des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia am Übergang zum Hinterhorn (5/26, 8/9 oder 3/125). Keine dislozierten Anteile. Kein Korbhenkelriss. Keine relevante Chondropathie femorotibial. Geringes subkortikales Ödem im medialen Tibiaplateau. Kreuzbänder intakt. Außenmeniskus intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Geringe Flüssigkeit um das MCL, DD bei Reizzustand. Signalanhebungen am Ansatz der Quadrizepssehne und am Ursprung der Patellasehne (8/28), in erster Linie bei Reizzustand. Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen in die umgebende Subcutis. Deutlicher Gelenkerguss mit im medialen und lateralen Recessus gelegenen kleinen länglichen Strukturen (3/25). Umgebende Muskulatur und Subkutis unauffällig.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia izquierda. Condropatía patelofemoral.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no contacta de
manera categórica la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de la región central de la zona de carga
del cóndilo femoral medial. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin
alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor total con discretos cambios óseos secundarios a la
rótula de distribución difusa.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón cuadricipital,
tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites conservados.
Impresión:
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 y 4 de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal

Findings: Mild - moderate knee effusion is noted. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Osteophyte formation is noted in all three compartments. Minimal fraying is seen in the medial and lateral compartment articular cartilage. No cartilage loss.  T T T G distance is widened and measures 18 mm. There is mild - moderate patellofemoral dysplasia. Lateralization of the patella is noted with resulting severe lateral patellofemoral degeneration and complete cartilage loss.  
Conclusion: Patellar maltracking with severe lateral patellofemoral degeneration.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial knee pain for one week.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Healed non-ossifying fibroma at the distal femoral metaphysis.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. Moderate extrusion of the body without discrete tear by MRI criteria.
Medial compartment cartilage: Low-grade fissuring at the notch third of the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss with subchondral edema and cystic change at the medial patellar facet and median ridge. Full thickness fissuring of the lateral facet. Partial thickness cartilage loss with full-thickness fissuring at the central and lateral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt. No lateral translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
High-grade patellofemoral compartment chondrosis. Low-grade medial and lateral compartments chondrosis.
